_comment: First production config of the rebuilt pipeline, 2026-08-19. Every line of printed text below is quoted verbatim from the artwork with its own colour, per the label-text-must-be-quoted rule: an invented label is clean, legible and plausible, so it survives a fast review in a way a garbled one does not. Bottle wording read off refs/product_tight.png; carton wording read off the corrected .ai dieline (Glutathione-Brightening-Serum-Skingenetix-box.ai), not from memory.
product_desc: Skingenetix Glutathione Brightening Radiant Glow Serum: a 30ml frosted white glass dropper bottle, straight-sided with square shoulders, fitted with a brushed silver-aluminium collar and a white rubber-bulb pipette. Reproduce the front label exactly as in the reference, every character verbatim. The colour words below describe the INK each line is printed in and must never themselves appear as text on the product: the Skingenetix DNA-helix mark and the 'Skingenetix' wordmark in BLACK, spelled with a CAPITAL 'S' and the rest lower case, with no registered-trademark, copyright or any other symbol anywhere near it; a narrow vertical GOLD rule down the left of the text block; 'GLUTATHIONE BRIGHTENING' in BLACK bold capitals on two lines; 'RADIANT GLOW SERUM' in GOLD bold capitals on two lines; 'PREMIUM FORMULA' in BLACK light capitals; and '2% GLUTATHIONE  |  30ML' in small BLACK capitals at the base. The volume is 30ML - never 50ML. The sub-line is 'PREMIUM FORMULA' - never 'PROFESSIONAL TREATMENT'. Keep the frosted glass WHITE and neutral: do not tint it amber, gold, cream or yellow. The collar is brushed satin aluminium with a fine vertical grain, not a chrome mirror. The metal is NEUTRAL SILVER-GREY and stays neutral under warm light - never rose-gold, copper, champagne, brass or warm-tinted. PIPETTE PROPORTIONS: the white rubber bulb is an ELONGATED CAPSULE about 1.6 times taller than wide, standing about ONE THIRD the height of the glass body; bulb plus collar together about TWO THIRDS of it. Never short, squat, stubby or ball-shaped. THE BOTTLE CARRIES ONLY THE LINES LISTED ABOVE - not the benefit triplet, not 'ALL SKIN TYPES', not any ingredient list. Those are carton-only. BRAND ACCENT COLOUR: GOLD, a warm matte antique gold. Any brand colour, gradient or accent glow builds from that gold and warm neutrals - never purple, navy, blue, pink or green. The frosted glass stays NEUTRAL WHITE under every setup: warm light and gold surroundings light the bottle, they do not dye it.
_packaging_desc_help: Written face by face because a model renders a box in one colour unless told otherwise, and because the carton carries far more text than the bottle. Source: the corrected dieline. The carton is ONE box with two differently-coloured large faces - it is not two product variants.
packaging_desc:
The product carton is a tall slim rectangular box, 41 x 41 x 99mm, noticeably taller than it is wide. It has TWO large faces in different colours meeting at crisp edges, each colour holding right up to the edge. One large face is matte metallic gold; the other is matte metallic brushed pale silver - not white cardboard, not a mirror. Both large faces carry the SAME lines of text, in this order top to bottom, and these are the ONLY words printed on them:
1. the Skingenetix DNA-helix mark with the wordmark 'Skingenetix'
2. 'GLUTATHIONE BRIGHTENING' - bold capitals, two lines
3. 'RADIANT GLOW SERUM' - bold capitals, two lines
4. 'ANTIOXIDANT DEFENSE' / 'DARK SPOT CARE' / 'FRESH COMPLEXION' - three lines
5. 'PREMIUM FORMULA'
6. 'ALL SKIN TYPES' - small
7. 'GLUTATHIONE 2%  |  BRIGHTENING PEPTIDES' and 'STABLE VITAMIN C  |  30ML' - small capitals
A narrow vertical rule sits to the left of the text block.
INK COLOURS - these describe the ink each line is printed in and are NEVER themselves printed as words. On the gold face: lines 1, 3 and 6 are printed in white ink, the vertical rule is white, and everything else is printed in black ink. On the silver face: those same elements are printed in gold ink and the rule is gold, everything else black. No colour name - not white, silver, gold, rose or black - ever appears as text on the packaging.
The narrow side panels are printed in the same gold and silver and carry ingredient and directions text too small to read - render it as fine unreadable print, never as placeholder words. The volume on every panel reads '30ML' - never 50ML. FINISH - the references disagree, so follow these words: the stock is matte-metallic satin. The photographed references were shot glossy; that is the photography, not the product. Render a soft brushed sheen with broad diffuse falloff across each face - never a mirror, never polished foil, never chrome. PRINT NOTHING NOT LISTED ABOVE - do not invent, translate, paraphrase or add wording, claims or ingredient names on any face.
_refs_local_help: product_tight.png MUST stay first - Luma reads refs[0] and nothing else, and on a product shot the bottle is what it must get right. logo_mark.png follows: it is the brand artwork at native size, added 2026-08-20 because engines kept substituting a ribbon or an X for the DNA helix and splitting the wordmark's weight. On a product shot the helix is about 70px and soft, which is not enough to copy. Luma will ignore it; the multi-reference engines will not. pack_full.png stays excluded - the equivalent Glutathione crop carried a superseded label.
_refs_packaging_help: box_artwork_flat.png leads. It is flat artwork rather than a photograph, but it is the only carton reference with the corrected 30ML wording, and it is the one Luma will see. The two photographed faces follow for perspective, edge geometry and finish. KNOWN AND ACCEPTED: both photographed cartons predate the 30ML fix and still read 50ML, and both are rendered glossier than the real satin-metallic stock, so expect some packaging candidates to show the wrong volume and a mirror sheen.
_gemini_used_today: Gemini calls already spent today across ALL products; the cap is 250 and nbp_pro and nbp_flash share it. The health check spent 2 (one each). Preflight also reads the ledger and takes whichever number is higher.
